---
title: "Cluster hierárquico"
output: html_document
date: "2024-09-04"
---

```{r}
install.packages("gridExtra", dependencies=T)
library(factoextra)
```
Cria o cluster

```{r}
hc = hcut(iris[,-5], k = 3, hc_method = "complete", stand = T)
hc
```
Dendograma
```{r}
plot(hc)
```
Dendograma
```{r}
g1 = fviz_dend(hc, show_labels = FALSE, rect = TRUE,ggtheme = theme_bw(),main = "Cluster Hierárquico")
plot(g1)
```


Cluster 

```{r}
g2 = fviz_dend(hc, ellipse.type ="norm", ggtheme = theme_bw(),
               main = "Cluster Hierárquico")
plot(g2)

```
Comparação
```{r}
plot(g1)
plot(g2)
```
